title: [IMP-02] Set up PPAP reference lists and operating settings

Source plan

Task ID
IMP-02

Title
Set up PPAP reference lists and operating settings

Category
Lists and settings

Objective
Give PPAP a consistent set of selections and known review/reminder defaults.

Detailed scope
Create seven independent PPAP reference lists with their exact fields and known starting values, plus the Operating Policy fields and settings form. Load controlled SIA values only when supplied; require complete role/timezone connections before activating the default policy.

Deliverable
PPAP lists, known starting entries, and an operating-policy form with controlled defaults.

Work needed first
IMP-01 — Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-01 provides the new Objects, native stage/termination identities and target-record marker.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: all list/policy fields and the eleven known list entries can proceed; controlled SIA entries and policy activation wait for the listed content, group/role references and timezone.

Recommended implementer role
Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The record/list settings and known starting values follow an established pattern. An Associate Consultant can build them while a separate Senior Consultant reviews conditional behavior and supplied values.

Default PPAP policy entry
Create Code=PPAP_DEFAULT. Set Reminder Lead Days=3, Overdue Reminder Interval Days=7, Escalation Overdue Days=7, Engineer Review Days=5 and Management Review Days=5. Set Drawing Review Days=14 and read only. Populate Business Time Zone, PPAP Administrators, Default Management Approver Pool, Model Engineer Role, Running Change Engineer Role and Process Change Engineer Role from their supplied governed records. Permit exactly one active default after required values are complete.

Build instructions
1. Create each list as a concrete independent localizable Object with native audit/security; no abstract catalogue family is added. Provide one Code, Name, Active? and Sort control per list. Make Name localizable for future translations and keep Code untranslated; launch labels are English. Keep references to inactive entries readable and block new selections of them.
2. Enter only the supplied SIA category/phase/stage/exception values, one record per Code with its approved Name, Active? and Sort. Do not substitute the OOTB eighteen elements or five levels.
3. On the policy form require whole nonnegative lead/escalation/review days; require overdue interval at least 1. Lock the confirmed 14-day drawing-review value. Prevent activation with missing required references/timezone or a second active default.

How to check the result
• The known Codes NEW_MODEL, RUNNING_CHANGE, PROCESS_CHANGE; SUPPLIER, INTERNAL, INSPECTION, JOINT; TEXT, NUMBER, BOOLEAN and DATE are separate records with the exact labels/order in their rows.
• Inactive list entries cannot be newly selected but historical references remain visible.
• The default policy cannot activate without required groups, role references and timezone; drawing review remains fixed at 14 calendar days.

Information needed for this task
IN-01: Supply the exact category, schedule phase, manufacturing stage and drawing-review exception records. Their list structures and the eleven known type/pattern/answer entries can proceed.
IN-05: Supply the administrator group, management pool and three internal engineer library-role references used by the policy. Group creation and membership administration are not assigned here.
IN-10: Supply the business timezone identifier for Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. The numeric defaults and form can proceed before that selection is made.

Supplied input context
• IN-01 — Client PPAP library and procedure: The client has been asked for the controlled SIA PPAP spreadsheet, procedure, IntelliQuest requirements/questions and template/classification matrix. They have not yet been supplied. Their exact content, protection rules, routing, dates and approved category/phase/stage/exception values are needed to complete the affected configuration; Objects and known controls can proceed.
• IN-05 — Approved SIA roles, supplier roles and capability rules: The SRM/security owners must supply the governed library-role and exact-entity role identifiers, populated memberships, SIA engineer selections, inspection teams/leaders, management approver pool and PPAP administrator group. They must also supply central ACTIVE/SERVICE/INACTIVE capability identifiers and reconcile the annotated central open-work transition rule. These are existing shared authorities; membership administration and central policy decisions are outside the build assignments.
• IN-10 — Business timezone and native notice scheduling: SIA must supply its business timezone. The technical team must supply the native reminder/delivery settings for the proposed daily 08:00 scan, repeat prevention, retry and access checks at delivery. Calendar-day values are known; the timezone and native connection cannot be inferred from the workstation.

Assumptions and open questions
New operational PPAPs only. SIA PPAP Engineer means an internal SIA user; supplier personnel act through their separate supplier roles.
